cohort: 231 twin deliveries at Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital between January 1, 2007 and December 31, 2009
finding: Twin delivery is associated with prematurity, malpresentations, and operative delivery, leading to increased perinatal and maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred in 57.4% of twin births, while 40.0% were delivered by Cesarean section, most commonly due to breech presentation of the leading twin.
birth_weight: 2.4 kg for the first twin and 2.3 kg for the second twin
